column2: I would do anything for my family, but it is hard work to foster loyalty and devotion, not only towards me but among all the quarrelsome members of our great House. When I am gone, the harmony I leave behind will be my greatest legacy.
Hear me roar!

House [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] stands firm on the rock of its proud [Root.GetPatriarchMatriarch], [Root.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal]! Cousins who would not share a table now share a cup, and the young ones come to me before they go to anyone else.

Clan [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] stands firm on the rock of its proud [Root.GetPatriarchMatriarch], [Root.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal]! Grudges between cousins that festered for a century have been struck from the clan book, and the beardlings learn the names of their ancestors at my knee.
I shall be genial and well liked.
I shall master the game of life.
No, I seek another lifestyle.
I have been spending more time with my [target_spouse.GetHusbandWife] [target_spouse.GetFirstName] lately, and though of course we did not marry for love, I can tell it is growing between us.

I have been spending more time with my [target_spouse.GetHusbandWife] [target_spouse.GetFirstName] lately. Our marriage was a contract between clans, weighed in gold and oaths like any other, but there is something more between us now, solid as good stone.
Ah, marital bliss!

I have been making an effort to spend more time with my [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName]. We have not always seen eye to eye, but as [From.GetPossPronoun] liege it is all the more important that I win [From.GetPossPronoun] loyalty and respect.
I have been writing regularly to my [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName], and I make sure to see [From.GetObjectPronoun] whenever I can. It is a harsh world, and kin must stand together against it.
My little [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] adores me, and I love playing with [From.GetObjectPronoun]. It is good to lay the groundwork for the years ahead...
Family first!
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName], the [GetRootFromCompliment] [From.GetManWoman], can always count on me. I help wherever and however I can, out of respect, if not always love.

It is hard to find the time, but whenever I can I spend some of it with my [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName]. [From.GetSubjectPronounCap] must learn how much family matters, and to honour and love [From.GetPossPronoun] parents!

I have been writing regularly to my [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName], and I make sure to see [From.GetObjectPronoun] whenever I can, to give sage advice and remind [From.GetObjectPronoun] of [From.GetPossPronoun] duties.
As a reigning [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetRulerTitle] I rarely have a moment to spare, but for my little [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] I would move mountains!

I have noticed that [target_first.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] and [target_second.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] are not on the best of terms, and I mean to put that right! I have invited them both to [Root.Capital.Capital.GetName] for some time together as a family.

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] has invited me to [From.Capital.Capital.GetName] for some time with the family. I am sure the idea is for me to make friends with [target_second.GetTitledName].
That sounds nice!
What idiocy! I think not.

My [GetFromFromRelation] [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] has invited me to [FromFrom.Capital.Capital.GetName] for some time with the family. I am sure the idea is for me to make friends with [From.GetTitledName]...
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] has refused my invitation. There will be no reconciliation with [target_second.GetTitledName].
How foolish!
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] has refused my invitation. There will be no reconciliation with [target_first.GetTitledName].

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal] refused [target_initiator.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal]'s invitation for us all to spend some time together in [target_initiator.Capital.Capital.GetName]...
How silly of [From.GetObjectPronoun]!
[From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal], [target_initiator.GetFirstName] and I had a wonderful time together! I feel our family bonds are stronger for it.
We should do it again some time.
[From.GetFirstName], [FromFrom.GetFirstName] and I had the best of times together! I am sure they like each other better now.

Constant fights and vicious pranks: my two children [target_second.GetFirstName] and [target_first.GetFirstName] never seemed able to get along, but my efforts to teach them love and respect have finally borne fruit. Their friendship will serve them well when I am gone...

Pulled beards, broken toy axes and a grudge sworn over a stolen honeycake: my two children [target_second.GetFirstName] and [target_first.GetFirstName] never seemed able to get along. But I have made them strike that grudge from their little book together, and their friendship will serve the clan well when I have gone to the Halls of the Ancestors.
Who can you trust, if not your siblings?

Young, unwed and not too hard on the eyes, I find the court full of maidens who seek my attention. One of them, bold and almost irresistible, has made it plain that she desires the pleasure of my company tonight...
Surely one night's passion won't tarnish my soul?
I won't soil my soul with a night of passion!
Not tonight. The Prince of Pleasure will be displeased.
My unwed daughter [daughter_with_bastard.GetFirstName] has been... indiscreet. She hid her pregnancy from me and now presents me with her child.
Pay heavily to deal with it quietly.
The child is of my blood and I will take care of them both.
Punish her harshly and give the child away!
[Root.job_spymaster.GetTitledFirstName] advises you on how to deal with your daughter's bastard child

'There are several ways to deal with this unfortunate situation,' [Root.GetSpymasterName] [Root.job_spymaster.GetTitledFirstName] told me when I asked [Root.job_spymaster.GetHerHim] how to deal with my daughter's bastard child...
'Keep her hidden, then dispose of the child.'
'Slay the father and take the child away.'
I don't want to know. Just deal with it...
[This.GetTitledFirstName] takes care of the matter of your daughter's bastard child

My liege [From.GetTitledFirstName] came to me, dragging [From.GetHerHis] daughter along with a newborn child in her arms.\n'I trust you to deal with my daughter's bastard discreetly,' [From.GetTitledFirstName] told me coldly, and left [From.GetHerHis] daughter and her child with me.
This is just part of my job.
What an interesting opportunity...
[Root.GetTitledFirstName] failed to cover up [This.GetTitledFirstName]'s daughter's unwanted child.
I trusted [From.GetTitledFirstName] to deal with my daughter and her bastard child discreetly, but [From.GetSheHe] failed miserably! The whole court is whispering about it.
Accuse [From.GetTitledFirstName] of treason and imprison [From.GetHerHim]!
I confess my part in this blunder.
I pardon everyone.
[Root.GetTitledFirstName] spared [This.GetTitledFirstName]'s daughter and her bastard child
Despite my clear orders on how to deal with my daughter and her bastard child, [From.GetTitledFirstName] let them both live!
As long as I am not involved, again...

'A bastard can cause a great deal of trouble,' [Root.GetSpymasterName] [Root.job_spymaster.GetTitledFirstName] insists, and tells me of a chance to rid the court of young [bastard_child.GetFirstName]. A fall from the battlements, a slip on the stairs... children are so careless.
Go ahead. See if your plan works.
I doubt the child will cause any trouble.
My bastard [bastard_child.GetSonDaughter] [bastard_child.GetFirstName] has come before me and asked me to recognise [bastard_child.GetHerHim] as my legitimate heir.
Not a chance.
I'm not sure you are worthy, yet.
I welcome you with open arms!
Am I not all that any child could be? I should ask my father to include me in the succession!
I'll ask him right now.
Why bother?
[Root.GetTitledFirstName] asks [Root.GetHerHis] father [This.GetTitledFirstName] to legitimise [Root.GetHerHim]
My illegitimate [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstName] asked me to acknowledge [From.GetHerHim] as my [GetFromRelation] and include [From.GetHerHim] in the succession.
Unthinkable!
I agree. You are a worthy heir.
I waited silently and patiently for my father [From.GetTitledFirstName] to answer my request. At last [From.GetSheHe] answered...
...that it was unthinkable!
...that [From.GetSheHe] agreed, and would make me [From.GetHerHis] lawful child.
Raising a child alone is hard, but raising a bastard is harder still. We are an embarrassment to the family, and few of them are willing to help us.
My father might be able to help us.
I keep quiet and toil on.
[Root.GetTitledFirstName] asks her father [This.GetTitledFirstName] for help
The black stain on our dynasty that is my daughter [From.GetTitledFirstName] and her bastard child asked me today for help. I refuse, and lay the blame for the shame brought upon the family on...
...my daughter [From.GetTitledFirstName].
...my daughter's bastard child.
...the father of my daughter's bastard child.
The father, [This.GetTitledFirstName], is blamed
[From.GetTitledFirstName] blames me for the hard straits [From.GetHerHis] daughter is in, since I am the father of her bastard child...
I am guilty.
That has nothing to do with me!
The grandfather, [This.GetTitledFirstName], is blamed for not raising his son properly
[From.GetTitledFirstName] blames me for the hopeless straits [From.GetHerHis] daughter is in, since my son is the father of her bastard child...
I will take care of it.
That has nothing to do with me, or my son!
They call me bastard, and they think that is all I will ever be. But I have the wits and the will of any trueborn heir, and more. A dream is born and a sword is sharpened...
The seed is planted.
The other children at court tease me without mercy because I have no real father. I'm a bastard, and they know it!
Fight them back!
Hide from them.
Try to make friends with them.
Pay them back when they can't tell it was me.
People keep calling me a bastard, but no one tells me what it means! Maybe [Root.Guardian.GetTitledFirstName] knows?
What does 'bastard' mean?
[Root.GetTitledFirstName] asks [Root.GetHerHis] guardian [This.GetTitledFirstName] what being a bastard means
[From.GetTitledFirstName] looked up at me with big, innocent eyes and asked, very seriously, what being a 'bastard' actually means.
You are an abomination in the eyes of the gods.
It means you will inherit nothing.
It means you will make your own way in the world!
Your parents sinned when they made you.
It means you were made in pleasure, as the Prince of Excess wills.
Avoid [Root.Liege.GetHerHim].
I've caught [Root.Liege.GetTitle] [Root.Liege.GetFirstName] eyeing me...
Encourage [Root.Liege.GetHerHim].
The [Root.Liege.GetTitle] responds to my glances
I am starting to think [From.GetTitledFirstName] might fancy me...
Make a move.
It's not appropriate!
[From.GetSheHeCap]'s not my type.
You will go to [This.GetHerHis] chamber...
I awaken to the sound of my door creaking open... It's [Root.Liege.GetTitle] [Root.Liege.GetFirstName]!
What took you so long?
Talk [From.GetHerHim] out of it.
Scream for the guards!
[This.GetTitledFirstName] becomes my lover
I went to [From.GetFirstName]'s chamber and we did not sleep much that night.
It's good to be the [This.GetTitle].
[This.GetTitledFirstName] is disappointed
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has spurned my subtle advances.
How could [From.GetSheHe] resist my charms?
[This.GetTitledFirstName] is embarrassed and resentful
[From.GetFirstName] screamed and made a fuss in front of my own guards! The tale is all over the castle by morning.
How dare [From.GetSheHe]!

There are members of our dynasty who hold land but have no children to carry on their legacy. I have children of my own, and I am more than fit to take a share of that inheritance before it passes to strangers.
I deserve a claim on a title!
I deserve a title!
Better not to stir up the family.
Will look at your demand for a claim.
Will weigh your need for a title.
[From.GetBestName] is asking for a claim on one of our titles, as [From.GetSheHe] believes [From.GetSheHe] is entitled to part of our inheritance early.
Grant [From.GetHerHim] a legal claim.
Refuse such outrageous demands!
[From.GetBestName] believes that [From.GetSheHe] should be granted a title from us, given [From.GetHerHis] competence and the worry that we have no children to inherit.
Grant [From.GetHerHim] a title!
Refuse such outrageous demands!
I have a claim on a title, and it should rightfully be mine. The head of my family has the swords to take it.
Ask our liege to fight for our land!
Let it lie, for now.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] will consider it.
My [GetFromRelation], [From.GetTitledFirstNameNoRegnal], keeps asking me to press [From.GetPossPronoun] claim on [claimant_claim.GetName] for the glory of our dynasty.
Prepare for war!
Refuse such outrageous demands!

I am of the blood of [Root.Liege.GetTitledFirstName], and yet I own not a single field. Lesser men hold counties in my liege's name while I wait at court like a hound for scraps. It is time I asked for what is owed to me.
I will ask for a county of my own.
Your liege will hear your request.

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has come before me with a request. [From.GetSheHeCap] wants a county of [From.GetPossPronoun] own to rule, and reminds me that the blood of our house runs in [From.GetPossPronoun] veins as it does in mine.
You shall have one. I give you my word.
You are not ready yet.
The temples have need of a mind like yours, [From.GetFirstName].
There is nothing I can spare, I am afraid.
Your relative will wait for the promised county.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has promised me a county. I am to have land of my own at last. The promise had better not prove hollow.
I will hold you to your word.
Your relative will be offended.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has turned me away with soft words and a smile. I am of the same blood, and I am to have nothing. I will remember this.
This will not stand!
Your relative will be disappointed.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] says I am not yet ready to rule. Not yet. I have heard that before.
Then I will ask again in a few years.
Not again! I will not forget this.
If my own kin will not give me land, I will take it. I will find a lord abroad who will lend me swords.
Years have passed since [Root.Liege.GetTitledFirstName] promised me a county of my own, and I am still waiting. It is time to remind my liege of that promise.
I will remind my liege of the promise.
Your liege will be reminded of the promise.
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] is back again, reminding me of the county I promised [From.GetObjectPronoun]. [From.GetSheHeCap] will not let it rest.
Oh, very well. Take it, and stop pestering me.
I have had enough of your whining!
Your relative will learn that the promise is broken.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has broken the promise. There will be no county for me. My own blood has made a fool of me before the whole court.
This is an outrage!

[From.GetTitledName] has come to my court in exile, cursing the liege who broke a promise of land. [From.GetSheHeCap] speaks of armies, of ships, of a claim to be pressed. A pretender in my hall may prove useful.
Interesting.
Word has come that [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] has fled to the court of [From.GetTitledName] and is gathering swords there. The traitor means to come back and take by force what I would not give.
The treacherous dog!
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has asked me to find [From.GetObjectPronoun] a match. [From.GetSheHeCap] is of an age to wed and grows tired of sleeping alone.
I will find you a fitting match.
The temples have need of servants more than you have need of a spouse.
Your relative will be glad of the promise.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has promised to find me a match. I shall be wed!
Wonderful news!
Your relative will be disappointed.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] will not find me a match. I am to serve the temples instead, and grow old alone.
Bleak news.
A year ago [Root.Liege.GetTitledFirstName] promised to find me a match, and still no one has come to court for my hand. I will remind my liege.
I will ask again.
Your liege will be reminded of the promise.
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] reminds me that I promised [From.GetObjectPronoun] a match a year ago, and that nothing has come of it.
All right, all right! Here is someone at court for you.
You will serve the temples instead!
I have found no one fit for you.
But you are already married!
My liege would not find me a wife, so I have found one myself. We were wed in secret, and the priest was paid to keep quiet. It is done, and no one can undo it.
My liege would not find me a husband, so I have found one myself. We were wed in secret, and the priest was paid to keep quiet. It is done, and no one can undo it.
I am married now, whatever anyone says.
Your liege will learn of the secret wedding.
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has wed in secret, taking some nobody from my own court to wife without asking my leave.
My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has wed in secret, taking some nobody from my own court for a husband without asking my leave.
Ah well. Young love.
The insolence!
They will both rot in the dungeon for this!

You are bent low over your [Root.GetEducationTool], struggling to stay focused and keep your eyes open, when your [From.GetHusbandWife] [From.GetTitledFirstName] comes in. [From.GetSheHeCap] crosses the room and looks over your shoulder at the work. "Perhaps a fresh pair of eyes might help, dear [Root.GetHusbandWife]?"
Perhaps you are right, [From.GetFirstName].
Accept §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§!'s offer to help.
You don't think I can handle this on my own?
Refuse §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§!'s offer to help.

Your [From.GetHusbandWife] was schooled in [From.GetEducationSubject] like yourself, and quickly grasps the problem as you explain it. The two of you set to work, comparing [Root.GetEducationalTopicPlural] late into the night. [From.GetFirstName] is a most able [From.GetEducationRole]! Within the hour you have the beginnings of a solution.
A brilliant idea, [From.GetFirstName]! What else would you suggest?
Finish your work with the help of §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§!.
Let us retire to the bedchamber, my dear...
Leave the work for now and spend some time with §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§!.
